name: Neovius
author: E. T. Carter
description: A raymarched flight through a Neovius surface, a triply-periodic minimal surface of fat rounded pockets joined by narrow necks, softer and more bulbous than the gyroid or diamond. The camera drifts through while walls catch a soft light with topographic contour ribbing wrapping each pocket, hue turning with depth into fog. A sibling on the same 3D engine, with a warm organic character.

params.label: Cell frequency
params.effect: How tightly the pockets tile space — a few big chambers at the low end, a dense cluster of cells at the high end.

params.label: Thickness
params.effect: Thickness of the pocket walls — delicate membranes at 0, fat beams nearly closing the necks at 1.

params.label: Flight speed
params.effect: How fast the camera drifts through the pockets — hovering at 0, rushing through at full.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Glow and rim light bleeding off the walls — a matte solid at 0, a luminous membrane at 1.

params.label: Warp
params.effect: How much the lattice bends out of periodicity — crisp pockets at 0, a melted organic cavern at 1.

params.label: Hue turn
params.effect: How fast colour turns with depth and angle — a single tint near 0, a full spectral journey at the high end.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: Depth fog swallowing the far pockets — a deep clear view at 0, a close fog-bound chamber at 1.

params.label: Roll
params.effect: Rolls the view around the flight axis, reorienting the pockets.

params.label: Shape
params.effect: Morphs the shape from the bulbous Neovius pockets (0) to the cubic Schwarz-P chambers (1), through hybrids between.

params.label: Edge line
params.effect: Strength and width of the crisp contour where a wall turns from view — soft pockets at 0, hard-outlined cells at 1.

params.label: Contour lines
params.effect: Concentric topographic lines wrapping each pocket — clean walls at 0, a ribbed contour-map relief at 1.

params.label: Twist
params.effect: Spirals the whole lattice around the flight axis — straight chambers at 0, a corkscrewing vortex of cells at 1.

params.label: Pocket
params.effect: Shifts from thin minimal-surface walls (0) toward fat closed rounded pockets and tunnels (1) — the biggest lever on overall shape.

params.label: Cell stretch
params.effect: Stretches the cells along the flight axis — squashed flat cells at the low end, even pockets at 0.5, tall elongated tunnels at the high end.

params.label: Crystallize
params.effect: Blends the soft Neovius pockets toward the sharp crystalline Schwarz Diamond — round and bulbous at 0, faceted and angular at 1.
